records.substantive_source_rationale: The exact candidate assigns both first_end and whole_order_end to November 17, 1906 and asserts one administrative day for closing business. The complete original, visually read at PDF 89 / printed 76, authorizes this quarterly session on November 15, 1906 instead of October 1. There is no extra administrative day or November 17 term. Complete parent EO 317A, visually read at PDF 46-49 / printed 33-36, provides recurring quarterly sessions and continuation as long as public business requires. That is an indefinite business-dependent continuation rule, not a one-day wind-down allowance. The candidate itself says the calendar permission expires at the close of November 15 while calling November 17 its first inoperative civil date. These boundaries differ by a day: if treating the sole date-specific commencement permission as exhausted at the close of November 15, the next civil date is November 16, not November 17. No meeting occurrence, adjournment or actual administrative completion is proved by either source. The parent cannot supply the invented day. This date/factual rationale defect requires rejection of the selected exact whole-case version even without resolving every alternative legal characterization.
records.inventory_and_identity: The complete original contains one operative paragraph, a Roosevelt/President signature and September 20, 1906 White House dateline. Body agrees with the supplied EO_506 text. Allowed WPA/Lord crosswalk entry 44 identifies EO 506 by September 20 date and session subject; the printing itself contains no EO number. Parent crosswalk identifies EO 317A, April 1, 1905. The original modifies a single session's commencement date and does not independently appoint anyone, require a report, or create a new perpetual quarterly schedule.
records.effective_dates_and_earlier_candidates: September 20 is issuance; October 1 is the displaced original session date. November 15 is the authorized alternative commencement day. Parent-governed continuation does not establish a fixed actual ending of a session. No earlier ending was established in this review; the candidate's assertion of a separate session-search.json was not supplied as a source reference and was not inspected through producer artifacts. Frozen/candidate USC and eCFR number searches and OFR coverage are bounded; OFR begins in 1937 and USC edition stops October 9, 2026. I do not independently attest that these exclude every earlier event. This rejection approves no substitute version or ending date.
records.savings_residuals: No separate express savings or independent recurring command appears in EO 506. Historical validity of the substitution and acts of a session lawfully convened must be distinguished from fresh commencement authority. Parent session-duration and recurring schedule provisions remain separate; neither is terminated by this date substitution. No actual meeting performance is inferred.
